model:
tff('declare_$i1',type,'fmb_$i_1':$i).
tff('declare_$i2',type,'fmb_$i_2':$i).
tff('finite_domain_$i',axiom,
      ! [X:$i] : (
         X = 'fmb_$i_1' | X = 'fmb_$i_2'
      ) ).

tff('distinct_domain_$i',axiom,
         'fmb_$i_1' != 'fmb_$i_2'
).

tff(declare_e,type,e:$i).
tff(e_definition,axiom,e = 'fmb_$i_1').
tff(declare_a,type,a:$i).
tff(a_definition,axiom,a = 'fmb_$i_2').
tff(declare_a2,type,a2:$i).
tff(a2_definition,axiom,a2 = 'fmb_$i_1').
tff(declare_a3,type,a3:$i).
tff(a3_definition,axiom,a3 = 'fmb_$i_2').
tff(declare_a4,type,a4:$i).
tff(a4_definition,axiom,a4 = 'fmb_$i_1').
tff(declare_g,type,g: ($i * $i) > $i).
tff(function_g,axiom,
           g('fmb_$i_1','fmb_$i_1') = 'fmb_$i_1'
         & g('fmb_$i_1','fmb_$i_2') = 'fmb_$i_2'
         & g('fmb_$i_2','fmb_$i_1') = 'fmb_$i_2'
         & g('fmb_$i_2','fmb_$i_2') = 'fmb_$i_1'

).
